description: This Java class 'AuthorService' provides service-layer methods for managing 'Author' entities, including CRUD operations and counting, within a Spring application context.

classes.name: AuthorService
classes.description: Service class for managing authors, providing methods for CRUD operations and counting authors.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an author by their ID, returning an Optional<Author>.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all authors.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new or existing author to the repository.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all authors from the repository.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of authors.
